task_instance: Generate a SOX 404 testing package for the Procure-to-Pay control area, period 2025-Q3: control matrix, risk-based sample size determination, an actual random+targeted sample pulled from a synthetic 214-invoice AP population, a testing workpaper with pre-populated test steps for control AP-3 (three-way match), simulated test results, exception documentation, and a deficiency classification with remediation recommendations.
evidence: Work performed entirely in /tmp/.../exec_div/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__sox-testing@developer-sandbox/. Steps: (1) gen_population.py generates a reproducible (seeded) synthetic population of 214 AP invoices for 2025-Q3 (population.csv, total value $5,325,926.08), with ~5% of items deliberately lacking three-way-match evidence to simulate real exceptions; (2) the same script draws a risk-based sample of 25 items (20 simple-random + 5 targeted high-dollar, per the skill's per-transaction/high-risk sample-size guidance of 25-60) and writes sample_selection.json; ran `python3 gen_population.py` and confirmed console output listing all 25 sampled invoices with dates/vendors/amounts and match status; (3) gen_workpaper.py assembles the full deliverable per the skill's Workflow steps 1-7 (control matrix for 5 P2P controls, sample-size rationale, sample selection table, testing workpaper template with test objective/procedures/expected evidence for control AP-3, a Test Results table evaluating all 25 sampled invoices, an Exceptions Noted table for the 2 items that failed (INV-2025-00086, INV-2025-00047), a deficiency evaluation applying likelihood/magnitude/pervasiveness criteria and classifying the finding as a Deficiency with escalation guidance, remediation actions, and a conclusion checklist) into SOX_Testing_Workpaper_P2P_2025-Q3.md; ran `python3 gen_workpaper.py` successfully (171 lines written). Verified the deliverable by reading the full generated Markdown file end-to-end and by grepping for the 2 expected 'Fail' rows, confirming they match the 2 invoices flagged as missing match evidence in the underlying data. Files produced: population.csv, sample_selection.json, gen_population.py, gen_workpaper.py, SOX_Testing_Workpaper_P2P_2025-Q3.md. No connectors, credentials, or external services were needed -- the skill's core deliverable (sample selection + testing workpaper + control assessment) is a self-contained document/data-generation task fully achievable with local shell and file tools.
